story: Tom is a new boy in the class.
Anna is a girl. She says, Hello!
Tom says, Hi! My name is Tom.
Anna says, I am Anna. You are my friend.
The teacher says, Hello, Tom and Anna!
Tom is happy. Anna is happy.
chant: Hello, hello, what is your name?
Hello, hello, are you a boy?
Hello, hello, are you a girl?
Hello, hello, you are my friend.

story: Kim is in class.
The teacher says, Look at the alphabet.
Kim sees a letter. She sees a word.
Kim can spell her name.
She can write her name on the board.
The teacher says, Well done, Kim!
chant: Spell a word, spell a name.
Write the letters, write the words.
Well done, well done, you can spell!

story: Ben has some things on the table.
He has one book and two pens.
He has three balls and four apples.
Ben can count the things.
Anna says, I can count too!
They count to ten. It is fun!
chant: Count the apples, count the balls.

story: Lucy is in the garden.
She sees eleven flowers and twelve birds.
Lucy says, How many fish are in the water?
She counts thirteen, fourteen, fifteen fish.
Sam has sixteen, seventeen, eighteen, nineteen, twenty balls.
Lucy and Sam count them. Hooray!
chant: How many fish? How many birds?

story: Grace has a box of crayons.
She has a red crayon and a blue crayon.
She draws a green tree.
She draws a yellow sun.
Tom says, I like the colours!
Grace is happy. It is a nice picture.
chant: Red, red, I can see red.
Blue, blue, I can see blue.
Green, green, I can see green.
Yellow, yellow, I can see yellow.
